title: desk-light
style: warm handheld lifestyle footage, shallow depth of field, practical lamplight, muted teal and amber palette, no on-screen text

product.name: the Halo desk lamp
claims: adjusts to the light in the room

beats.panel: close on Sara at a dim desk at night, squinting at a laptop, one hand shielding her eyes from the screen glare
beats.action: Sara pushes back from the desk and rubs her eyes
beats.say: I thought I just needed more coffee.
beats.caption: I thought I just needed more coffee.

sound.ambience: a quiet flat at night, a fridge humming two rooms away

beats.panel: wide of the same desk, the only light a hard white ceiling bulb throwing a sharp shadow across the keyboard
beats.action: Sara tilts the laptop screen back and forth, hunting for an angle that does not glare
beats.caption: It was the light.

sound.ambience: the room tone, one chair creak
sound.music: a low sustained synth note entering

beats.panel: medium shot, Sara's hand reaching into frame to set the Halo desk lamp beside the laptop, its shade angled down over the keyboard
beats.action: Sara sets the lamp down and turns it on; warm light spreads across the desk
beats.caption: One lamp. That was it.

sound.ambience: a soft click, the room tone opening up

beats.panel: over-the-shoulder, the laptop screen now readable, the glare gone, Sara's face lit warm from the side instead of blue from the front
beats.action: Sara leans back in, relaxed, and starts typing steadily
beats.caption: No glare. No squinting.

beats.panel: the Halo desk lamp alone on the cleared desk, lit warm against the dark room, the laptop closed beside it
beats.action: the camera settles as the room light dims around the lamp
